reading_note: The teaching describes the spiritual process by which mixed states of natural truth (the "cloud") rise out of the lower regions carrying both captive good (light) and active falsities (archons), encounter the pure receptive medium of divine truth (the Virgin of Light), and there are sorted: the light is extracted upward, while the falsities either are bound and returned to their containment-pits, or break loose to inflict damage on natural goods until divine truths (angels) overtake them. Three distinct modes are taught: (1) cloud from fire — manifestation as lightning/thunder, where falsities from self-love are unmasked and stripped; (2) cloud from wind — violent purification through storm and hail, where escaping falsities damage seed-fruits and works until intercepted; (3) cloud from joined air — gentle still purification, where falsities are quietly transferred and good is restored. The arc ends with the captured falsities cast down to the seven pits beneath the great sea, beneath the feet of the Omophoros, the bearer of the cosmic structure — i.e. confined to the lowest containment in the natural-corporeal, while the rescued light ascends to its first form.
